_comment: Chinese literals that travel between the admin bundle and the backend as a VALUE, not as text. The bundle sends or compares one and the server compares the same literal, so translating only one side breaks the feature while the UI still looks fine — the worst kind of failure. server-messages.mjs refuses to rewrite them on the PHP side; wire-keep.mjs marks them __KEEP__ on the bundle side, in every module that carries one. The other side of each pair is listed so the coupling is auditable without re-deriving it.

模糊.why: Filter condition token. The admin bundle sends filter[].condition="模糊"; Admin/UserFetch and Admin/OrderFetch validate it with `required|in:>,<,=,>=,<=,模糊,!=`; the controller then maps it to SQL `like`. All three sites must agree, so it stays Chinese on both. Never rendered: it appears only inside a <select> option value and its label is a separate literal.
